title: Empty collection produces a non-finite mean
root_cause: The summary function stopped returning zero for an empty collection and now divides its zero total by the zero item count. The existing empty-input assertion receives NaN instead of zero. A later test-only change adds coverage for a single value without changing that assertion.

relevant_evidence.why: The empty-input test reports NaN where zero was expected.
The total is divided by the number of values without an empty-input guard.
